en.name: WB 4000 - Work Bench
en.description: Height and width adjustable work bench for workshops and general purpose use

GENERAL FEATURES: Work bench for window assembly and general purposes use
Adjustable height, fixed on ground and non- slide feet
Plate to hold the tool set for mount accessories
Opportunity to adjust working area according to profile size in two directions
Working surfaces are covered with rubber material which prevents scratches on work piece and also provides non-sliding
Standard with 6 pcs. of stacking bin
